name: Orkas
description: Open-source, local-first desktop AI workforce where Commander coordinates specialist project work, with supported own-provider API keys and compatible local model endpoints.
compatibility: Custom OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible model endpoints, including compatible local servers.
Reusable agent skills, private memory and local project files support Commander-coordinated specialist work.
limitations: Orkas is a desktop client and agent workspace, not a model inference server; a suitable model endpoint is configured separately.
Packaged installers cover macOS and Windows 10+; Linux currently runs from source on glibc 2.34+ x64 or arm64, not musl-based distributions.
Local endpoint compatibility depends on the selected model and supported protocol; no hardware or model-level runtime certification was performed.
Remote model providers and authorized external tools require network access and can receive task data; provider usage can cost extra.
The source build has no Orkas account layer; packaged official builds require sign-in and optional managed services have separate terms.

sources.note: Product definition, Commander and specialist workflows, local workspace defaults, own-provider keys, local model endpoint configuration, source startup requirements and packaged/source-build distinction.
